Let me analyze the opponent's team and figure out the best 3 Pokémon to bring.

Opponent's team: Garchomp, Scizor, Metagross, Rotom-Wash, Dragapult, Toxapex

- Garchomp: Dragon/Ground, fast physical attacker, can mega evolve
- Scizor: Bug/Steel, technician/UTurn threat
- Metagross: Steel/Psychic, can mega evolve
- Rotom-Wash: Electric/Water, defensive pivot with Will-O-Wisp
- Dragapult: Dragon/Ghost, very fast special attacker
- Toxapex: Poison/Water, defensive wall with Toxic Spikes

My options:
- Gholdengo: Steel/Ghost, special attacker, immune to status (Good as Gold). Great against Fairy, Poison, and can handle Dragapult. Weak to Ground (Garchomp) and Fire.
- Corviknight: Flying/Steel, physical wall, defog, uturn. Good against Fighting, Bug, Grass. Weak to Electric, Fire.
- Arcanine-Hisui: Fire/Rock, physical attacker with Head Smash. Good against Steel (Scizor, Metagross), Bug, Ice. Weak to Ground (Garchomp), Water, Fighting.
- Rotom-Wash: Electric/Water, defensive pivot. Good against Fire, Water, Flying, Steel. Weak to Grass, Ground.
- Clefable: Fairy, Calm Mind + Moonblast. Good against Dragon, Fighting, Dark. Weak to Steel, Poison.
- Dragapult: Dragon/Ghost, very fast special attacker. Good against Steel, Ghost. Weak to Dark, Ghost, Dragon, Ice.

Let me think about matchups:

Against Garchomp: Clefable resists Dragon, Arcanine-Hisui is weak to Ground. Gholdengo is weak to Ground. Corviknight resists Dragon but not Ground. Dragapult resists nothing special.

Against Scizor/Metagross: Arcanine-Hisui with Head Smash/Flare Blitz is great. Gholdengo can handle them with Make It Rain (neutral) or Shadow Ball on Metagross.

Against Toxapex: Gholdengo is immune to Toxic (Good as Gold), and can hit with Make It Rain. Arcanine-Hisui can hit with Head Smash. Clefable is weak to Poison.

Against Dragapult: Gholdengo resists Dragon and is immune to Normal/Fighting (not relevant). Clefable resists Dragon. Arcanine-Hisui is neutral.

Against Rotom-Wash: Arcanine-Hisui can hit with Head Smash (super effective on Grass? No, it's Water/Electric). Actually Head Smash is Rock, which is neutral on Rotom-Wash. Flare Blitz is Fire, neutral. Hmm. Gholdengo can hit with Make It Rain.

Let me think about a good core:

Option 1: Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui, Corviknight
- Gholdengo handles Dragapult, Toxapex, Fairy types
- Arcanine-Hisui handles Scizor, Metagross, Steel types
- Corviknight handles Fighting, Bug, provides Defog

Option 2: Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui, Clefable
- Gholdengo handles Dragapult, Toxapex
- Arcanine-Hisui handles Scizor, Metagross
- Clefable handles Garchomp (Dragon resist), Fighting types

- Dragapult handles Steel types (Dracometeor super effective on Metagross)
- Arcanine-Hisui handles Scizor, Metagross
- Gholdengo handles Dragapult, Toxapex

Option 4: Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui, Rotom-Wash
- Gholdengo handles Dragapult, Toxapex, Fairy
- Arcanine-Hisui handles Scizor, Metagross
- Rotom-Wash handles Garchomp (resists Ground, can Will-O-Wisp), Fire types

Actually let me reconsider. The opponent has Garchomp which is a major threat with Mega Evolution. Arcanine-Hisui is weak to Ground, so it can't handle Garchomp. Gholdengo is also weak to Ground. 

Who can handle Garchomp?
- Corviknight: resists Dragon, but not Ground. Still takes neutral damage from Earthquake.
- Clefable: resists Dragon, immune to Ground (Fairy)? No, Fairy doesn't resist Ground. Clefable takes neutral from Ground, resists Dragon.
- Dragapult: neutral to both Dragon and Ground.
- Rotom-Wash: resists Ground (Water), neutral to Dragon (Electric/Water vs Dragon/Ground). Actually Water resists Ground! So Rotom-Wash resists Ground.

Rotom-Wash seems like the best Garchomp answer with Will-O-Wisp and Pain Split.

Let me go with: Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui, Rotom-Wash

- Arcanine-Hisui: handles Scizor, Metagross with Head Smash/Flare Blitz
- Rotom-Wash: handles Garchomp (resists Ground, Will-O-Wisp), provides defensive pivot

This seems like a solid core. Gholdengo leads for its ability to handle multiple threats and its typing makes it hard to switch into.

Actually, wait. Let me reconsider the lead. Gholdengo is great but if they lead Garchomp, Gholdengo is weak to Earthquake. Maybe Rotom-Wash should lead to handle Garchomp?

But Rotom-Wash as lead is slow and passive. Gholdengo can still switch out if Garchomp leads.

Let me think about what they might lead. Common leads: Garchomp, Dragapult, Toxapex.

If Garchomp leads: Gholdengo switches to Rotom-Wash. Arcanine-Hisui can't handle it.
If Dragapult leads: Gholdengo handles it well.
If Toxapex leads: Gholdengo handles it (immune to Toxic, Make It Rain).

I'll lead Gholdengo. It's the most versatile and handles the most common leads.

Final decision: Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui, Rotom-Wash
